callouts.title: 序列均匀分布的概念
callouts.body: 实数列$u_n$称之为在闭区间$[a,b]$上均匀分布(uniformly distributed/equidistributed)的,如果$$\lim_{N\to \infty}\frac{|\{n:1\leq n\leq N ,u_n \in [c,d]\}|}{N}=\frac{d-c}{b-a}$$其中$[c,d]\subseteq [a,b]$，即前$N$个序列$u_n$当中的落在闭区间$[c,d]$当中的元素的个数。

classification_result.english_title: Concept of Uniform Distribution of a Sequence

callouts.title: 实数模1的概念
callouts.body: 实数$x$可以表示为$$x=E(x)+\varepsilon(x)$$其中$E(x)$是一个整数,$\varepsilon(x) \in [-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$称之为实数$x$模1的余数。

classification_result.english_title: Concept of a Real Number Modulo 1

callouts.title: 序列模1均匀分布的概念
callouts.body: 实数列$u_n$称之为模1均匀分布的,如果$$\lim_{N\to \infty}\frac{\nu(a,b,N;u_n)}{N}=b-a$$其中$[a,b]\subseteq [-1/2,1/2]$。此处$$\nu(a,b,N;u_n):=|\{n:\varepsilon(u_n)\in [a,b],1\leq n\leq N\}|$$表示序列$u_n$模$1$形成的序列$\varepsilon(u_n)$的前$N$项目落在闭区间$[a,b]$中的个数。

classification_result.english_title: Concept of Uniform Distribution Modulo 1 of a Sequence

callouts.title: 非均匀分布的例子
callouts.body: 简单的例子$u_n=\frac{1}{n}$,其模1以后，$$\varepsilon(u_1)=0,\varepsilon(u_1)=-\frac{1}{2},\varepsilon(u_n)=\frac{1}{n},n\geq 3$$首先这个序列组成的集合根本不在$[-1/2,1/2)$中稠密，比如考察$[-1/2,0]$这样一个区间当中，其中只包含$-1/2$这样一个元素，那么序列在此区间当中比例的极限为0，而不是$1/2$。

classification_result.english_title: Example of a Non-Uniformly Distributed Sequence

if_problem.statement_en: A simple example is $u_n=\frac{1}{n}$. After reduction modulo $1$, $$\varepsilon(u_1)=0,\varepsilon(u_2)=-\frac{1}{2},\varepsilon(u_n)=\frac{1}{n},n\geq 3.$$ This sequence is not uniformly distributed modulo $1$; for instance, in the interval $[-1/2,0]$ there is only the element $-1/2$, so the limiting proportion of terms in this interval is $0$ rather than $1/2$.
key_techniques: test the definition on a specific interval

callouts.title: 非模1均匀分布的例子2
callouts.body:
假设$r_n$是对$[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$之间的有理数的一种枚举方式。然后定义$$\xi_n:=\begin{cases}r_{n}&100|n\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}$$比如考察区间$[\frac{1}{4},\frac{1}{5}]$，前$N$个序列$\xi_n$的元素当中有不超过$N/100$个元素落在此区间里面。于是最后比例的极限肯定是小于等于区间长度$1/4-1/5 = 1/20$的。不过和之前的例子不同的是，此序列在$[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$当中是稠密的。

这里我们虽然用$100|n$这个条件增加了$\xi_n =0$的频率，减少了其落在$[-\frac{1}{2},0),(0,\frac{1}{2})$的频率，但是因为有理数的稠密性，序列$\xi_n$对应的集合依旧是稠密的。

classification_result.english_title: Second Example of a Sequence Not Uniformly Distributed Modulo 1

if_problem.statement_en: Let $r_n$ be an enumeration of the rational numbers in $[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$, and define $$\xi_n:=\begin{cases}r_n&100\mid n\\0&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$$ Then $(\xi_n)$ is not uniformly distributed modulo $1$. For example, for a fixed interval such as $[\frac{1}{5},\frac{1}{4}]$, among the first $N$ terms at most $N/100$ lie in this interval, so the limiting proportion is at most $1/100$, not the interval length $1/20$. Nevertheless, the set of values of the sequence is dense in $[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$.
key_techniques: construct a sparse perturbation of a dense set
compare limiting frequency with interval length

callouts.title: Weyl判别,1916
callouts.body:
以下三者等价：
1.  $u_n$模1均匀分布
2.  对于任意非零整数$k$    $$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}e^{2\pi ik u_n}\to0$$

3.  对于任意连续函数$f:[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}]\to\mathbb{C}$有$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(\varepsilon(u_n))\to\int_{-1/2}^{1/2}f(x)dx$$

if_problem.statement_en:
The following are equivalent:
1. $u_n$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
2. For every nonzero integer $k$, $$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}e^{2\pi i k u_n}\to0.$$
3. For every continuous function $f:[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}]\to\mathbb{C}$, $$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(\varepsilon(u_n))\to\int_{-1/2}^{1/2}f(x)\,dx.$$

callouts.title: 引理1.2.1
callouts.body: $f\in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$那么对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在一个多项式$P_{\varepsilon}(z)$使得$$||f-P_{\varepsilon}||_{u}<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: If $f\in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$, then for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a polynomial $P_{\varepsilon}(z)$ such that $$\|f-P_{\varepsilon}\|_{u}<\varepsilon.$$

callouts.title: 引理1.2.2
callouts.body:
$f\in C([-1/2,1/2]\to \mathbb{C})$并且满足$f(-1/2)=f(1/2)$那么对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在一个三角多项式$P_{\varepsilon}\in \mathcal{P}$使得我们可以定义$T_{\varepsilon}(x):=P_{\varepsilon}(e^{2\pi i x})$使得
$$||f-T_{\varepsilon}||_{u}<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: If $f\in C([-1/2,1/2]\to \mathbb{C})$ and satisfies $f(-1/2)=f(1/2)$, then for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a trigonometric polynomial $P_{\varepsilon}\in \mathcal{P}$ such that, defining $T_{\varepsilon}(x):=P_{\varepsilon}(e^{2\pi i x})$, one has $$\|f-T_{\varepsilon}\|_{u}<\varepsilon.$$
key_techniques: identify periodic functions with functions on the circle

callouts.title: 引理1.3.1
callouts.body: $f$是$[-1/2,1/2]$上实值的黎曼可积的函数，那么对任意$\varepsilon>0$存在一个$g_{\varepsilon} \in C([-1/2,1/2]\to \mathbb{C})$使得$$\int_{-1/2}^{1/2}|f(x)-g_{\varepsilon}(x)|\,dx<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: If $f$ is a real-valued Riemann integrable function on $[-1/2,1/2]$, then for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $g_{\varepsilon} \in C([-1/2,1/2]\to \mathbb{C})$ such that $$\int_{-1/2}^{1/2}|f(x)-g_{\varepsilon}(x)|\,dx<\varepsilon.$$
key_techniques: approximation of Riemann integrable functions by continuous functions

callouts.title: 引理1.4.1:Darboux夹逼
callouts.body: $f$闭区间$[a,b]$上的Riemann可积函数，对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在$[a,b]$上定义的step function $g_{\varepsilon},h_{\varepsilon}$，使得对所有$x\in [0,1]$都有$$g_{\varepsilon}(x)\leq f(x)\leq h_{\varepsilon}(x)$$并且$$\int_{a}^b (h_{\varepsilon}(x)-g_{\varepsilon}(x))<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: If $f$ is a Riemann integrable function on the closed interval $[a,b]$, then for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exist step functions $g_{\varepsilon},h_{\varepsilon}$ on $[a,b]$ such that for all $x\in [a,b]$, $$g_{\varepsilon}(x)\leq f(x)\leq h_{\varepsilon}(x),$$ and $$\int_a^b\bigl(h_{\varepsilon}(x)-g_{\varepsilon}(x)\bigr)\,dx<\varepsilon.$$

callouts.title: 命题1.4.2：Weyl判别的加强
callouts.body: 序列$x_n$模1均匀分布，当且仅当对于定义在区间$[0,1]$上的任意黎曼可积函数$f$，成立$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(\{u_n\})\to\int_{0}^{1}f(x)dx$$

if_problem.statement_en: A sequence $x_n$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$ if and only if for every Riemann integrable function $f$ defined on $[0,1]$, $$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(\{u_n\})\to\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\,dx.$$
key_techniques: approximation of integrable functions by simple or continuous functions

callouts.title: 命题2.1.1
callouts.body: $u_n=b\log(n)$对任意的$b$，此序列都不会是模1均匀分布的。

if_problem.statement_en: For any $b$, the sequence $u_n=b\log(n)$ is not uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
key_techniques: apply Weyl criterion or density arguments

callouts.title: 命题2.1.2
callouts.body: $\log(n)$模1的余数再对应的区间中是稠密的。

if_problem.statement_en: The remainders modulo $1$ of $\log(n)$ form a dense subset of the corresponding interval.

callouts.title: 命题2
callouts.body: $u_n=n\gamma$,其中$\gamma$是任意的一个正无理数，该序列是模1均匀分布的。

if_problem.statement_en: Let $u_n=n\gamma$, where $\gamma$ is any positive irrational number. Then the sequence is uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
key_techniques: geometric series cancellation for irrational rotations

callouts.title: 命题3
callouts.body: $u_n=an^{b},a\neq0,b\in(0,1)$,那么这个序列是模1均匀分布的。

if_problem.statement_en: If $u_n=an^{b}$ with $a\neq0$ and $b\in(0,1)$, then this sequence is uniformly distributed modulo $1$.

prerequisites: continuity and integrability of trigonometric functions
change of variables on periodic intervals

if_problem.statement_en: The sequence $n^2$ modulo $2\pi$ is uniformly distributed on $[0,2\pi]$.

callouts.title: van der Corput's difference theorem,1931
callouts.body: 如果序列$u_{n+h}-u_n$是模1均匀分布的对任意正整数$h$成立，那么$u_n$也是模1均匀分布的。

if_problem.statement_en: If for every positive integer $h$, the sequence $u_{n+h}-u_n$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$, then $u_n$ is also uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
key_techniques: reduction of equidistribution to shifted differences

callouts.title: 命题6
callouts.body: 比如$\{\frac{0}{1},\frac{0}{2},\frac{1}{2},\frac{0}{3},\frac{1}{3},\frac{2}{3},\dots\frac{k-1}{k},...\}$的序列是模1均匀分布的。

if_problem.statement_en: For example, the sequence $$\left\{\frac{0}{1},\frac{0}{2},\frac{1}{2},\frac{0}{3},\frac{1}{3},\frac{2}{3},\dots,\frac{k-1}{k},\dots\right\}$$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
key_techniques: counting rational points with bounded denominator
compare block averages with interval length
